crossRefs.note: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness…
Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.
It will happen, that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of…

people.name: Beer-elim
people.line: Place mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy against Moab.

people.name: Eglaim
people.line: Moabite city; its destruction prophesied by Isaiah

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.
translations.bsb: For their outcry echoes to the border of Moab. Their wailing reaches Eglaim; it is heard in Beer-elim.
translations.kjv: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.
translations.asv: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the wailing thereof unto Eglaim, and the wailing thereof unto Beer-elim.
